note: CICIDS2017 HistGradientBoosting (200 iterations, max_bins=255, seed 0), framework prediction vs ONNX Runtime, 447,275-row test split. Isolates the skl2onnx threshold-rounding defect (removed by onnx/sklearn-onnx PR 1227, on main) from the float64-vs-float32 front-end scaler.
reading: Of the 1,362 framework-vs-export flips under the released converter, 963 are the threshold rounding (the float32-scaled comparison, which the fix takes to 0); the rest are the front-end float64 scaler, which the fix does not touch and which grows once thresholds are tuned for float32 inputs.
